title: National Water Reuse Action Plan progress: Year Four progress update
summary: EPA's year-four update extended the national implementation record. The reporting rail still requires metered operating outcomes.
key_findings: EPA's year-four update extended the national implementation record.
Method: Annual federal and partner reporting on WRAP actions and milestones.
Denominator: Actions and partner activities included in each WRAP annual progress update.
Attribution: EPA and partner administrative reporting.
why_it_matters: This observation adds one of three time points for the national water reuse action plan progress series and keeps its unit, denominator, period, geography, method, attribution, and series-break context attached.
ftfn_relevance: Adds one of twelve Phase 56A primary records for asset-level grid, water, storage, and mineral performance.
Supports a within-domain time series without creating a cross-domain score.
Makes revision, denominator, and method limits visible before a direction is described.
evidence_limits: The reporting rail still requires metered operating outcomes.
The observation is bounded to United States and the stated period.
The denominator is Actions and partner activities included in each WRAP annual progress update.
Two-point movement is not presented as a durable trend without an explicit caveat.
